name: Sukumizu Fetish no Oneesan
original_name: スク水フェチのお姉さん
source:
During spring break, you get to stay at my cousin Rinka's place!
You haven't seen Rinka in 10 years She has become really busty and athletic, and lives all by herself!
As you live together, you catch Rinka changing clothes!

She takes off her clothes.
Revealing her body underneath.
It's wrapped in a tight, neatly fitting, deep blue...

Swimsuit!?

春假期间，你可以住在我表弟Rinka的家里！

它被一件紧身、整齐、深蓝色的包裹着……
